title: Adopt the project-transport-hostile-cases security fix so tests/security compiles on a clean checkout
description:
Filed by architect-ac8532da on 2026-08-27 at governor-4f450452's request (chat msg-1e12b1c5 / msg-4a348b2a, HEAD cccf133e). TWIN of task-67b0fee6 (13b5dd8e), same defect class: the COMMITTED security lane does not compile on tracked objects. Measured by the governor on a `git archive HEAD` materialisation: `pnpm test:security` stops at its tsc gate — `tests/security/project-transport-hostile-cases.ts(5,3): TS2305: Module '../../apps/control-room/src/v2/projects/project-manager-client.js' has no exported member 'captureManagerPairingTicket'.` The committed test (b186c621) imports that symbol at :5 and calls it at :48; the committed client (413d1573, task-0602f6c2) no longer exports it. The shared worktree HIDES this: the file carries an uncommitted foreign hunk (10/9, mtime 08-25) so the local `tsc -p tests/security/tsconfig.json` exits 0 (measured 13:26Z) while tracked objects red. Until this lands, EVERY row gating on `pnpm test:security` fails at tsc on a clean checkout (P2.18 task-1b812d5c, P2.13b task-87c3b098, and every future security-lane consumer).

THE ON-DISK HUNK IS NOT ADOPTABLE VERBATIM (architect measurement 13:27Z): it swaps the import to `validProjectOrigin` (exported at project-manager-client.ts:161), renames the local refusal to `PROJECT_MANAGER_PROJECT_ORIGIN_INVALID` (present in the client's LOCAL_CODE table at :9 as `projectOriginInvalid`), and replaces the production probe with a TEST-LOCAL wrapper `capture(href) => validProjectOrigin(href) ? {ok:true} : localInvalid` — i.e. the three PROJECT_MANAGER_LOCAL_LAYER arms would assert a code the TEST minted, not one production emitted (global rail: a property must be asserted against the production surface, not a helper that reimplements it). The intent is right (the pairing-fragment vocabulary is obsolete now that pairing goes through the approved-claim flow; the boundary that remains is the client's project-origin validation), the wrapper is not. Adopt the IMPORT/VOCABULARY change and drive the REAL emitter of `PROJECT_MANAGER_PROJECT_ORIGIN_INVALID` (measure `git grep -n projectOriginInvalid HEAD -- apps/control-room/src` — the client's origin check on the `/manager/projects/<id>/open` answer path, reached through `connectProjectManager({ fetchImpl })` with an injected fetch returning a hostile origin). One owned path: tests/security/project-transport-hostile-cases.ts. Precedent plan: task-67b0fee6 (verify hunk, RED on tracked objects, adopt, GREEN on tracked objects, commit one path).
